_comment_shared: Atoms used by more than one of config / command / hud.
_comment_creatures: Hypixel's own mob names. Translate only if your language's SkyBlock community uses translated names; otherwise leave them as they appear in game.
_comment_policy: When a loot source is allowed to spin the reels. The wording says what each choice costs, not what the constant is called.
_comment_loot_sources: One caption per chance-based activity. Hypixel's own names for its content: translate only if your language's SkyBlock community uses translated names. Missing a key here is not an error - the screen falls back to the English caption the mod already carries.
skyprism.config.title: SkyPrism
skyprism.config.yacl_missing: SkyPrism's settings screen needs YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL). The mod works without it; only the GUI is missing.
skyprism.config.category.levels.tooltip: Colours for the [123] level prefix in chat, TAB and nametags.
skyprism.config.category.loot.tooltip: The slot machine on everything else in SkyBlock.
skyprism.config.category.hud.tooltip: Where the slot machine sits and how it looks.
skyprism.config.levels.enabled.desc: The master switch for level tag colouring. Off leaves Hypixel's own colours alone on every surface, and costs nothing at runtime.
skyprism.config.levels.mode.desc: Brackets is what the mod ships on: hard bands, and the shipped table changes colour every 20 levels below 480 in Hypixel's own thirteen colours, then every 10 levels from 480 to 600 where Hypixel has only dark red. Gradient blends instead, so every single level is its own shade along a ramp. Vanilla reproduces Hypixel's thirteen stock tiers exactly, which is the one to pick if you only want the chroma effect.
skyprism.config.levels.recolour_brackets: On, the square brackets around the number are recoloured with it. Off, only the digits change and the brackets stay as Hypixel sent them.
skyprism.config.levels.group.surfaces.de: Each surface is independent. The TAB list is the expensive one - it is rebuilt for every player on screen - so turning it off is the first thing to try if you ever suspect SkyPrism of costing you frames.
skyprism.config.levels.apply_chat.desc: Recolour level tags in chat messages. This is the cheapest surface: a message is rewritten once, when it arrives.
skyprism.config.levels.apply_tab.desc: Recolour level tags in the player list. Results are cached per player, so the cost is a rebuild when someone's name changes rather than a cost per frame.
skyprism.config.levels.only_skyblock.des: Recolour only while you are actually in Hypixel SkyBlock. A SkyBlock level prefix does not exist anywhere else, and nothing about the token tells [451] apart from a teammate typing "we need [2] more" in a Bedwars lobby, so leaving this on is what stops the gradient turning up where it makes no sense. Turn it off to recolour bracketed numbers on every server.
skyprism.config.levels.apply_nametags.de: Recolour level tags on the names floating over players in the world. Turn this off if you want coloured levels in the interface but Hypixel's own colours in the world itself.
skyprism.config.levels.preset.desc: Picking a preset copies its stops into the two lists below, ready to tweak. Choose "custom" to keep your own stops and stop tracking a preset. "spectrum" is the default ramp, drawn as soon as you switch the mode to Gradient: an even hue sweep across the whole level range, so two players forty levels apart are obviously different colours. "vanilla_plus" is Hypixel's own thirteen tiers smoothed out, which is familiar but spends much of its range in similar greens and aquas. "aurora", "ocean", "sunset", "ember", "toxic", "neon" and "candy" are narrower moods, and "mono" and "rainbow" are the two extremes.
skyprism.config.levels.stop_levels.desc: The level each colour below is anchored to. Levels between two stops get a blend of their colours, so a handful of stops covers every level. Row 1 here pairs with row 1 of the colour list underneath.
skyprism.config.levels.stop_colours.desc: One colour per stop level above, in the same order. The blend between them is done in Oklab, so a red-to-green ramp passes through clean yellows instead of the muddy browns a plain RGB fade gives you.
skyprism.config.levels.bracket_levels.de: The lowest level in each band of the table the mod ships on. A level takes the colour of the highest band it reaches, so bands starting at 0, 100 and 200 colour level 150 with the 100 row's colour. There are 37 shipped - one every 20 levels up to 480, then one every 10 up to 600 - and room for 64, so you can split a band you care about without deleting one you do not.
skyprism.config.levels.bracket_colours.d: One flat colour per band above, in the same order. No blending happens in this mode - every level in a band is exactly this colour. Below 480 the shipped ones are Hypixel's own tier colours and the midpoints between them, so the scale still reads the way you are used to; above 480, where Hypixel gives every level the same dark red, they are SkyPrism's own.
skyprism.config.levels.group.chroma.desc: An animated rainbow shimmer for high levels. It replaces the palette colour rather than tinting it, so a shimmering tag reads as "this player is off the top of your scale". Shimmering tags cannot be cached between frames, so keep the threshold high enough that only a few players in a busy lobby qualify.
skyprism.config.levels.chroma_enabled.de: Animate the tags of players at or above the threshold below. Off, every tag keeps a fixed palette colour and nothing has to be redrawn between frames.
The lowest level that shimmers. Levels below this keep their static palette colour and stay cacheable, so raising this threshold is the direct way to cut what chroma costs in a crowded lobby.
skyprism.config.levels.chroma_speed.desc: Full colour cycles per second. Around 0.2 to 1.0 reads as a slow shimmer; much faster reads as a strobe and gets tiring fast.
skyprism.config.levels.chroma_saturation: How vivid the shimmer is. 0 is grey; 1 is fully saturated and smears into the chat behind it. The shipped 0.90 keeps the colour obvious while the digits stay readable.
How light the shimmer is. Legible values sit between 0.50 and 0.70; the shipped 0.62 stays brighter than the grey chat text around it.
skyprism.config.levels.chroma_hz.desc: How many times a second a shimmering tag is redrawn. This is a cost cap, not a speed control - lowering it makes the animation steppier but does strictly less work per frame.
skyprism.config.levels.group.detection.d: The range of numbers SkyPrism is willing to read as a level. Narrowing it is how you stop a bracketed number in someone's chat message from being mistaken for a level tag. Emblems to the right of a name are never touched regardless of these values.
skyprism.config.levels.min_level.desc: Numbers below this are left alone. Raise it if short bracketed numbers in chat keep getting recoloured.
skyprism.config.levels.max_level.desc: Numbers above this are left alone. Raise it as Hypixel's cap rises.
skyprism.config.diana.enabled.desc: The master switch for the slot machine. Everything it does also sits behind a mayor check, so it costs nothing while Diana is out of office.
skyprism.config.diana.only_my_burrows.de: Ignore kills from other players' burrows nearby, so a busy Hub does not spin the reels on loot you never received.
skyprism.config.diana.suppress_drop_line: Hide the drop lines in chat
The reels already show what you got, so the chat lines are duplicated information. Off by default because hiding chat is a big thing to do on your behalf.
skyprism.config.diana.group.triggers.des: Which Mythological Ritual kills spin the reels. Minos Inquisitor, King Minos and Manticore start switched on: turn every creature on and a routine Minotaur becomes an event, so the machine stops meaning anything.
skyprism.config.diana.trigger.rare.desc: A rare spawn, and the kind of kill worth stopping to watch. Minos Inquisitor, King Minos and Manticore are the three that start switched on.
skyprism.config.diana.trigger.common.des: A common spawn, off to start with. Switch it on only if you want the reels running on nearly every kill.
skyprism.config.diana.group.timing.desc: How the spin is paced. The reels lock one after another, so the last reel settles at spin time plus stagger times the number of reels.
skyprism.config.diana.reels.desc: How many symbols land. Fewer reels than drops means the extra drops are not shown, so three is a good match for a typical kill.
skyprism.config.diana.loot_window.desc: How long after the kill SkyPrism keeps listening for drop lines. Too short and a late drop misses its reel; too long and the next kill bleeds into this one.
skyprism.config.diana.spin_length.desc: How long the reels blur before the first one locks.
skyprism.config.diana.lock_stagger.desc: The gap between one reel locking and the next. Zero locks them all at once, which loses most of the tension.
skyprism.config.diana.settle.desc: How long the finished result stays on screen before it starts to fade.
skyprism.config.diana.fade.desc: How long the fade itself takes.
skyprism.config.diana.group.jackpot_timi: A jackpot changes nothing about the spin until the reels would have started landing -- and then they do not land at all. Gold washes over columns that are still turning, they keep turning faster, and they come to rest one at a time on the same item, so the whole roll is one movement with a single stop at the end. These four times pace that second act, and none of them costs anything on a kill that does not pay out.
skyprism.config.diana.jackpot_intro.desc: How long the gold takes to wash in. The reels break loose again at the start of it, so the machine turns gold while it is already spinning rather than pausing to change colour first. Zero makes the gold snap on.
skyprism.config.diana.jackpot_spin.desc: How much longer the reels keep turning once the gold wash is complete, before the first one lands.
skyprism.config.diana.jackpot_stagger.de: The gap between one reel landing on the jackpot item and the next. Zero lands all three together, which throws away the reveal - a slot machine that shows three of a kind at once shows nothing.
skyprism.config.diana.jackpot_hold.desc: How long the three of a kind stays on screen before it fades.
skyprism.config.diana.allowed_areas.desc: Islands the slot machine is allowed to run on, read from the sidebar. Empty means anywhere, which is the default. Filling it in stops a rare drop from unrelated content -- a slayer, a dungeon run -- being credited to Diana when it lands shortly after a burrow.
skyprism.config.diana.jackpot_items.desc: Drops that earn the jackpot celebration: instead of landing on the real loot the reels roll straight on into gold and land together on this item, three of a kind. Names are matched ignoring case, without colour codes. Blank rows are dropped when you save.
_comment_loot: The SkyBlock-wide slot machine: one landing tab, then one tab per part of the game.
skyprism.config.loot.group.master.desc: The two settings that apply to every source at once. Everything finer lives on the tabs beside this one, so no setting appears twice and no two controls can disagree about the same value.
skyprism.config.loot.enabled.desc: One switch covering every source in Combat, Containers, Gathering and Events. It does NOT cover Diana, which keeps its own switch on the Diana tab -- the Diana path is the one verified on the live server and nothing here is allowed to change what it does. To silence everything new without touching Diana, turn this off.
skyprism.config.loot.suppress_drop_lines: Hide the drop lines in chat

The reels already show what you got, so the chat lines are duplicated information. This covers the new sources; Diana has a switch of its own so you can hide one and not the other. Off by default, because hiding chat is a big thing to do on your behalf.
Two blunt instruments. Neither takes effect until you press Save, so either can be undone by leaving without saving.
Unticks every source on every tab, one by one, exactly as clicking each box would. Diana is untouched. Use the master switch above instead if you only want to silence them for now -- this writes a decision per source, that one does not.
skyprism.config.loot.reset_everything.de: Throws away every switch, policy and jackpot list you have set for every source and goes back to what this build ships. Worth knowing: a source you have never touched stores nothing at all, so a later SkyPrism can correct a default it got wrong -- and this button puts you back in that position.
skyprism.config.loot.group.bulk.desc: The switch for the whole drawer, and the bulk actions for the sources in it.
skyprism.config.loot.enable_all.desc: Ticks every source in this category. It does not change their policies, so a source shipped as Never stays silent until you change that too.
skyprism.config.loot.disable_all.desc: Unticks every source in this category. If you simply want the category quiet, the switch above is lighter: it leaves each source's own setting alone, so turning the category back on restores exactly what you had.
skyprism.config.loot.reset_category.desc: Throws away every switch, policy and jackpot list in this category and goes back to what this build ships. Other categories are untouched.
skyprism.config.loot.category.combat.des: Kills: slayers, dungeon and Crimson bosses, dragons, and the rare-drop banner Hypixel prints across the whole server.
skyprism.config.loot.category.combat.too: Slayers, bosses, and rare mob drops.
skyprism.config.loot.category.containers: Things you open: reward chests, Glacite corpses, excavations, gifts and the Experimentation Table.
Things you gather: fishing, foraging on Galatea, the Garden, and the mining procs. This is where the loudest sources live, which is why most of them ship switched off.
skyprism.config.loot.category.events.des: Seasonal and one-off content: Hoppity's Hunt, the Chocolate Factory, the Rift and the Carnival.
skyprism.config.loot.category.misc.desc: Sources that have not been filed under a part of the game yet. This drawer should be empty; if anything is in it, that is a gap in SkyPrism rather than something you did.
skyprism.config.loot.source.enabled.desc: Whether this source may spin the reels at all. The master switch, the category switch and this one all have to be on, and switching a category back on does not undo a source you turned off by name.
skyprism.config.loot.source.policy.desc: Every time - spin on every trigger, right for anything minutes apart that you are already waiting on. Only when Hypixel says rare - spin only on a server rarity flag, right for anything that arrives several times a minute. Only jackpot items - spin only when the drop is on the list below, for the frequent sources Hypixel prints no rarity for. Never - shipped off, switch it on if you disagree. A choice that could never fire, such as waiting for a rarity flag on content that prints none, is dropped when you save rather than leaving you a setting that silently does nothing.
skyprism.config.loot.source.jackpot.desc: Drops that earn the three-of-a-kind celebration from this source, separated by commas and matched ignoring case and colour codes. Leave it blank to use the list SkyPrism ships, which is what almost everyone wants -- a blank box is not an empty list. Type a single hyphen for a genuinely empty list, meaning nothing from this source ever celebrates.
skyprism.config.hud.enabled.desc: Off hides the HUD entirely while leaving drop tracking running.
skyprism.config.hud.background.desc: A dark panel behind the reels. Worth keeping - item names over open sky are close to unreadable without it.
skyprism.config.hud.background_opacity.d: 0 is invisible, 1 is solid black. Somewhere around 70%% keeps item names readable without blocking out what is behind them.
skyprism.config.hud.show_creature_name.d: Print which creature triggered the spin above the reels.
skyprism.config.hud.show_drop_names.desc: Print each drop's name in small text under its item sprite. Worth leaving on: several Diana drops share a base item or are a small brown shape at sprite size, and anything SkyPrism has no icon mapped for is unreadable without the caption. Turning it off leaves the sprites alone, and a drop with no icon keeps its name anyway.
skyprism.config.hud.group.placement.desc: The anchor decides which corner of the machine is pinned; the two sliders then move that anchor around the screen. Anchoring to a corner keeps the machine put when the window is resized.
skyprism.config.hud.anchor.desc: Which part of the screen the position is measured from. Pick the corner nearest where you want the machine, so it stays put when the window changes size.
skyprism.config.hud.x.desc: 0 is the left edge, 1 the right.
skyprism.config.hud.y.desc: 0 is the top edge, 1 the bottom.
skyprism.config.hud.scale.desc: Size of the machine, multiplied on top of your GUI scale. Turn it down if the reels crowd whatever else you keep in that corner.
skyprism.config.sounds.enabled.desc: The master switch. Off silences everything below without changing them.
skyprism.config.sounds.volume.desc: Relative to your master volume, so the game's own slider still applies on top.
skyprism.config.sounds.reel_ticks.desc: A click as each reel locks. This is the sound that makes it feel like a machine; it is also the one that gets old fastest.
skyprism.config.sounds.jackpot.desc: The louder cue when a jackpot item lands.
skyprism.command.status.heading: SkyPrism %s on Minecraft %s
skyprism.command.status.symbols: sprites   %s real  %s learned  %s fallback  %s none  (of %s on the reels)
skyprism.command.status.symbols.hint: fallback and none have never been captured; one real drop teaches SkyPrism that item's Hypixel art
skyprism.command.status.symbols.memory: learned   %s captured this session, %s item models remembered
skyprism.command.status.loot: Loot sources: %s of %s armed  %s gate(s) open here
skyprism.command.status.loot.shut: can fire   nothing on %s -- %s lists every source and the gate holding it shut
skyprism.command.sources.heading: Loot sources: %s of %s armed, %s gate(s) open here
skyprism.command.sources.filter.on: chat      pre-filtered on %s literal(s); a line matching none of them costs one scan and nothing else. %s source(s) declared no literal and are looked at on every line.
skyprism.command.sources.filter.off: chat      unfiltered -- a markerless source is open (the sea-creature announcements share no literal), so every line is looked at. Switching those off restores the pre-filter.
skyprism.command.sources.counters: session   %s rolled  %s deferred  %s turned away  (min interval %s ms)
skyprism.command.sources.contested: note      %s had two detector implementations; one was chosen and the other is unreachable dead code
skyprism.command.sources.none: No source matches "%s". Try a source id, a category (combat, dungeons, containers, mining, fishing, foraging, events, rift), or one of: all, armed, off, open.
skyprism.command.sources.more: Only the open gates are listed. %s shows every armed source, %s shows one category.
skyprism.command.loot.policies: Policies: %s. always rolls on every trigger; on_rare_banner waits for Hypixel to flag the drop; on_jackpot_item_only waits for a named item; never unregisters the detector entirely.
skyprism.command.loot.interval: Minimum interval between rolls: %s ms (default %s). An event arriving inside it is ignored rather than queued, so a burst is one spin instead of a stutter.
skyprism.command.loot.interval.session: This lasts until you restart the game; SkyPrism's settings file has no loot section yet.
skyprism.command.loot.unknown_source: I do not know a loot source called "%s".
skyprism.command.loot.unknown_policy: "%s" is not a policy. Use one of: %s
skyprism.command.loot.policy.no_banner: Careful: this source emits no rare-drop banner, so on_rare_banner means it will never fire.
skyprism.command.loot.policy.no_jackpot: Careful: no jackpot items are recorded for this source, so on_jackpot_item_only means it will never fire.
skyprism.command.preview.range_inverted: The maximum level (%s) is below the minimum (%s).
skyprism.command.preview.range_too_large: That range is %s levels; keep it under %s so the grid stays scrollable.
skyprism.command.hud.opened: Drag the slot machine where you want it; it saves when you close the screen.
skyprism.command.simulate.drops_hint: Everything after the source is the caption. Put a | before a comma-separated drop list to set both: "Obsidian Chest | Recombobulator 3000, 40000 coins". Leave the drops out and a plausible set is rolled from that source's real jackpot list.
skyprism.command.simulate.unknown_creatu: I do not know a creature called "%s". Try one of: %s
skyprism.command.simulate.no_drops: No usable drops in "%s". Separate them with commas, for example: Chimera I, 40000 coins
skyprism.command.simulate.heading: Simulating %s
skyprism.command.simulate.how.direct: driven straight through the Diana controller
skyprism.command.simulate.how.staged: Diana module not registered, so this was staged as chat lines instead; the gate may still suppress it
skyprism.command.simulate.sources: Or any of the %s loot sources by id -- %s lists them.
skyprism.command.simulate.unknown_source: I do not know a creature or loot source called "%s". Creatures: %s
skyprism.command.simulate.subject_or_dro: Read "%s" as the caption. If you meant those as drops, put a | in front of them.
skyprism.command.simulate.no_machine: The slot machine is not wired up, so there is nothing to spin.
skyprism.command.simulate.how.event: source %s, policy %s -- simulate ignores the gate, the policy and the minimum interval on purpose
skyprism.command.replay.format: One raw chat line per file line. Section signs may be literal, written as &a, or written as \u00A7a. Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped; "#wait 1500" inserts a pause.
skyprism.command.replay.paths: Relative paths resolve against the game directory: %s
skyprism.command.replay.stop_hint: /skyprism replay stop cancels a running replay.
skyprism.command.replay.bad_path: "%s" is not a usable file path.
skyprism.command.replay.missing_file: No file at %s. Relative paths resolve against %s.
skyprism.command.replay.superseded: Superseded a running replay (%s line(s) dropped).
skyprism.command.replay.truncated: Stopped queueing at %s lines; the rest of the file was ignored.
skyprism.command.replay.queued.skipped: Replaying %s line(s) from %s over %s, %s comment(s) skipped.
skyprism.command.stats.unavailable: The Diana module is not registered, so there are no statistics to show yet. /skyprism simulate still works.
skyprism.command.stats.heading: Diana statistics
skyprism.command.profile.heading: Performance, last %s
skyprism.command.profile.disabled: Recording is off; these are the totals from when it was last on.
skyprism.command.profile.tab.detail: %s hit rate (%s hit / %s miss), %s, %s rebuilds at %s
skyprism.command.profile.memo.detail: %s tab rebuilds, %s nametag rebuilds since launch (surfaces module)
skyprism.command.profile.cost.detail: %s ms/s total (%s of a 60 FPS budget): %s hud, %s chat, %s tab+tags
skyprism.command.profile.hint: /skyprism profile reset clears these; on and off toggle recording.
skyprism.command.profile.off: Performance recording off; the hot paths stop timing themselves.
_comment_hud_slot: The slot machine itself. One string: the Magic Find the jackpot prize was rolled at, drawn beside the JACKPOT headline on the reveal. %s arrives already carrying its sign and, when Hypixel sent one, its percent - "+240%%" or "+240" - so do not add a percent sign here. The star is SkyPrism's own mark and not Hypixel's icon, whose codepoint is private-use and renders as an empty box without Hypixel's resource pack; U+2605 is in Minecraft's own font. Replace it with a word if your language's font cannot draw it, but keep the string short - it shares a 12-pixel strip with the headline.
_comment_hud: Full-screen SkyPrism editors: the HUD placement screen and the palette preview.
skyprism.hud.placement.title: SkyPrism HUD placement
skyprism.hud.placement.hint: drag the box - arrows nudge, shift x10, alt disables snapping
skyprism.hud.placement.hint.sketch: drag the box - arrows nudge, shift x10, alt disables snapping   (HUD module not registered: this is a stand-in sketch)
skyprism.hud.preview.title: SkyPrism level palette
skyprism.hud.preview.disabled: recolour OFF - this is Hypixel's own colouring
skyprism.hud.preview.chroma.on: chroma on from level %s at %s cyc/s, %s Hz
skyprism.hud.preview.brackets.off: brackets left as Hypixel drew them
skyprism.hud.preview.unwired: level module not registered - showing a palette built from config
skyprism.hud.preview.hint: scroll or arrows to browse   levels %s-%s
